items.title: Deliver API gateway by November 7th
items.description: James to complete and merge the new API gateway before mobile sync work can begin.
items.evidence_quote: James, can you own the API gateway delivery? I need it done by November 7th. — Yeah, I can take that. November 7th works.
items.speaker: Sarah / James
items.reasoning: Clear owner (James), explicit deadline (November 7th), confirmed by both parties.

items.title: Create GitHub issues for dashboard UX problems
items.description: Engineering to create GitHub tickets for all dashboard UX issues identified in customer interviews.
items.evidence_quote: James, I want engineering to create tickets for all the dashboard UX issues Marcus identified. Can you do that? — Sure, I'll create the GitHub issues this week. Let's say by October 27th.
items.speaker: Sarah / James
items.reasoning: Explicit owner (James), clear deadline (October 27th), confirmed commitment.

items.title: Write accessibility violations report for design system
items.description: Priya to document all accessibility violations found during the component inventory audit.
items.evidence_quote: Can you have the accessibility violations report ready by end of next week? — That should be fine. I'll target October 30th.
items.speaker: Sarah / Priya

items.title: Produce export flow mockups (CSV and JSON)
items.description: Priya to design the export flow for both CSV and JSON formats for enterprise clients.
items.evidence_quote: Priya, can design produce the export flow mockups? — Yes, I can do those. I'll need until November 3rd for the mockups.
items.speaker: Sarah / Priya

items.title: Build CSV and JSON export API
items.description: James to implement the export API endpoint supporting both CSV and JSON output after the API gateway is complete.
items.evidence_quote: I can start on it after the API gateway. I'd estimate we wrap up the export API by November 14th.
items.speaker: James
items.reasoning: Clear owner (James), explicit deadline (November 14th), confirmed by James.

items.title: Survey enterprise clients on Teams vs Slack and provide recommendation
items.description: Marcus to survey enterprise clients about their notification platform preference and return with a recommendation.
items.evidence_quote: Marcus, can you survey the enterprise clients and come back with a recommendation? — Sure. I can get back to you by November 5th with that.
items.speaker: Sarah / Marcus

items.title: Design onboarding wizard redesign
items.description: Priya to lead design for the onboarding wizard redesign targeting a 15% drop-off reduction.
items.evidence_quote: Priya, I need your designs ready two weeks before that so engineering has time. So designs by November 14th. — Yes, that works.
items.speaker: Sarah / Priya

items.title: Implement onboarding wizard MVP
items.description: Engineering team to implement the onboarding wizard redesign. James flagged a potential resource conflict with the export API work in the same sprint.
items.evidence_quote: James, your team handles the implementation. Can we target a ship date of November 28th for the MVP onboarding redesign? — That's tight... I'd push back and say November 28th is more realistic.
items.speaker: Sarah / James
items.reasoning: Deadline confirmed (November 28th) but owner is 'the team' — James mentioned resource conflicts. Needs clarification on who specifically leads implementation.

items.title: CSV and JSON export is a confirmed Q3 feature
items.description: Both CSV and JSON export of task data are confirmed scope for Q3, driven by enterprise client demand.
items.evidence_quote: That's a confirmed feature for Q3... So the export feature covers both CSV and JSON — confirmed.
items.speaker: Sarah
items.reasoning: Sarah explicitly confirmed this as a Q3 feature decision. No owner/deadline needed for a decision item.

items.title: Analytics dashboard refactor deferred to Q4
items.description: The analytics dashboard refactor is removed from Q3 scope and deferred to Q4.
items.evidence_quote: I'd say we table it for Q4 and revisit. — Fair. Let's leave it off for now.
items.speaker: Marcus / Sarah
items.reasoning: Explicit decision to defer. No action required until Q4 planning.

items.title: Add JSON export alongside CSV for enterprise flexibility
items.description: Marcus suggested including JSON export in addition to CSV to provide more flexibility for enterprise integrations.
items.evidence_quote: I'd also suggest we add a JSON export option alongside CSV. Just makes it more flexible for enterprise clients.
items.speaker: Marcus
items.reasoning: Suggested by Marcus and accepted by Sarah, but this suggestion is already captured in the confirmed export decision. Flagged as potential duplicate.

items.title: Should notifications integrate with Microsoft Teams or Slack?
items.description: The team was unable to decide between Teams and Slack for notifications. Marcus will survey clients for a recommendation.
items.evidence_quote: There's a question around whether we should integrate with Microsoft Teams or stick with Slack for notifications. — I don't think we can decide that today.
items.speaker: Marcus / Sarah
items.reasoning: Explicitly left unresolved. A follow-up action item was created for Marcus to research this.

items.title: Friday sync to check on sprint resource split
items.description: Sarah and James to sync Friday to review whether the engineering team needs to be split across the export and onboarding implementation work.
items.evidence_quote: Let's sync again Friday to check. Okay, we're done.
items.speaker: Sarah
items.reasoning: Confirmed follow-up by Sarah but deadline is 'Friday' without a specific date. Needs clarification.

links.explanation: Item 5 (Build CSV and JSON export API) and Item 11 (Add JSON export alongside CSV) both refer to implementing JSON export. The suggestion is already captured in the confirmed action item.

Item 5 (export API due November 14th) and Item 7 (onboarding implementation due November 28th) are both assigned to James/engineering in overlapping sprints. James explicitly flagged a resource conflict. These tasks may compete for the same engineering capacity.

summary: The team discussed API gateway delivery, mobile sync challenges, and CSV export features. Key commitments include James delivering the gateway by November 7th and the team clarifying onboarding flow requirements before implementation.
